Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vinod - 30 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Pallavi - 64 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Anjali - 36 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Shalini - 29 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez
5. Karan - 33 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The ghat - stone steps, the flowing river

Scene 1: The ghat - Day

[Vinod stands on the ghat. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "What lovely weather!"

[Vinod drowns in the river.]

Pallavi: "Rest in peace."
